verdict.rationale: Pilot's bookkeeping and CFO service pages reference real-time account data, custom workflows/reporting, and budget-vs-actuals/scenario planning, implying standard financial statements are produced as part of monthly bookkeeping, and community reviews confirm books are kept accurate and up to date. However, no evidence explicitly confirms generation of a P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any arbitrary period on demand. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the three core statements, confirmation of on-demand/any-period generation (vs. standard monthly close), and independent verification of statement accuracy/timeliness.
